title: Zesty Double Fried American Tiger Prawns Skillet
description: A solo dinner American dish featuring tiger prawns, double fried for a crispy exterior and a springy interior, with a zesty and umami flavor profile, and ayurvedic sattvic friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix together the flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Toss the tiger prawns in the flour mixture to coat, shaking off excess.

Double fry the tiger prawns by first frying them for 2 minutes, then removing them from the oil and letting them rest for 30 seconds, and finally frying them again for an additional 2 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove the fried tiger prawns from the oil and place them on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess oil.
In the same skillet, add the lemon juice and stir to deglaze the pan, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Add the fried tiger prawns back into the skillet and toss to coat with the lemon juice and pan drippings.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve immediately.
Serve the zesty double fried American tiger prawns skillet hot and enjoy.
